name: uam-mcp
description: Publish, version and organize assets in Unity Asset Manager — assets and versions, file upload and download, metadata, references, collections and projects.

UNITY_VPC_FQDN.title: Private cloud (VPC) host
UNITY_VPC_FQDN.description: Hostname of your Unity private cloud deployment (e.g. private-cloud.example.com). Leave blank for standard public Unity Cloud. When set, Asset Manager talks to your deployment and sign-in uses its identity service instead of Unity ID. IMPORTANT: if you also use the Unity Pipeline Automation plugin, set the SAME value there. The two share one sign-in, and a token minted for one deployment is refused by the other — a mismatch shows up as a permanent 'not logged in'.

UNITY_VPC_PATH_PREFIX.title: Private cloud path prefix
UNITY_VPC_PATH_PREFIX.description: Path prefix in front of the service paths on your private cloud ingress — commonly 'backend' (giving https://<host>/backend/assets/v1/...). Leave blank if the services are served at the host root.

UNITY_VPC_OPENID_CONFIG_URL.title: Private cloud OpenID configuration URL
UNITY_VPC_OPENID_CONFIG_URL.description: Optional override for the deployment's OpenID Connect discovery URL. Leave blank to use the standard location (https://<host>/auth/realms/unity/.well-known/openid-configuration).

UNITY_VPC_CLIENT_ID.title: Private cloud OAuth client id
UNITY_VPC_CLIENT_ID.description: Public OAuth client used for the browser sign-in on your private cloud. Defaults to 'dashboard'.

UNITY_VPC_ASSETS_PATH.title: Private cloud Asset Manager service path
UNITY_VPC_ASSETS_PATH.description: Service path for Asset Manager on your private cloud, relative to the host and prefix. Defaults to 'assets/v1'.

UAP_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS.title: Restrict file access to these directories
UAP_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS.description: Optional list of directories (separated by ';' on Windows, ':' elsewhere) that every local file this server reads or writes must sit inside — uploads and downloads. Leave blank (default) to allow any location except credential stores and auto-executed startup files, which are always refused. Plugin settings are per plugin: if you also use the Unity Asset Transformer plugin, set the same value there.
